english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something dedicated to a god or religion or revered as sacred.
This is the all-purpose choice for something holy or godlike.
This is the all-purpose choice for something holy or connected with religious worship.
Use this when godly means holy or sacred, especially when describing a place, object, or occasion rather than a person's devotion.
Choose this when spiritual means sacred, holy, or deserving special reverence.
Use this for the sacred or divine sense, especially in a religious context, rather than for casual praise.
